intelligence.human_view: Think of the agreement like a house he already furnished, beautifully, and every round someone comes in and replaces a chair with a different chair. He does not want a new chair. He wants the chair that is already there — the black button, raised like a real button, with a faint white shine across it — used everywhere, always the same. The pretty red N is a jewel: it sits under the words, in the middle of the space below them, with air all around it, never pressed against the edge. The little circle spins while Naya speaks, and the blue rays behind it swirl slowly, because the show is supposed to move. The legal links sit quietly just below the frame, where you find them when you scroll. The slides never make you scroll: picture, a few words, then a page of words that finishes the picture's story, then a picture again — you just tap the little arrow and the next page pops up. And underneath it all, one habit keeps the whole house light: keep only the best, let the rest go. If anyone tells you a rule is his, ask for his words — if the words are not there, the rule is not his.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine the buttons on a page are like the buttons on your favorite coat! They are always the same ones, black and shiny and raised up, never a brand-new kind! The pretty red N sits right under the words, with lots of air around it, like a jewel in the middle of a cushion! The little circle spins and sparkles when Naya talks, and the blue rays swirl around behind it like a merry-go-round! The words never spill off the page — you just tap the little arrow and BOOM, the next page pops up! And if anyone tells you a rule, ask them: did Shawn really say that?
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — the buttons should be the same ones every time, dear, the lovely black ones, raised up like real buttons, with a faint white shine across them — never white, never purple, never a brand-new one! The pretty red N sits right under the words, love, with lots of air around it, never squished against the bottom edge! The little circle spins while Naya talks, dear, and the blue rays swirl behind it, because the show is meant to move! The words never spill off the page, love — you just tap the little arrow and the next page pops up, nice and easy! And if anyone tells you a rule is his, dear, ask to hear his own words — if the words aren't there, it isn't his rule!
intelligence.naya_view: Take the house button everywhere: obsidian black, raised, real, faint white swish, a light around the edge — never white, never purple, never new; small, arrow-only, just above the fold. Red N centered under the saying and at the bottom of every board, in the text box only, with breathing room; crystal N in the corner, untouched; only one red N ever. Board ~15–20% wider on desktop; prove the 390px phone layout and report exactly what happens; desktop-only widening if the phone breaks. Restore the motion as it was: orb flowing in a circle with her voice, background rays rotating slowly — verify both move on the live page, never by source alone. Legal bar just below the frame, in the flow, ten links, slim and quiet, never sticky; prove it by scrolling the served page. Slides: image + a little text, then a text-only continuation, then image again — never scroll, every frame in view, click to move. Essence is the standing habit: keep only the best, let the rest go, consistently, always. Every deploy carries a render gate: the claimed artwork seen resolving on screen before it ships; a failed render stops the deploy. And no seat states a rule as his without quoting his words for it, verbatim, with the time and place — his rule is live-first: finished work live immediately as a freeze point.
